ambiguities.text: The EIP states MAX_ATTESTATIONS is 'reduced' but does not specify the exact new value in the summary.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the new value is specified in the ethereum/consensus-specs repository and achieves the stated 4x voting capacity increase.

ambiguities.text: The term 'pre-cache verification' for gossip mutation mitigation is not precisely defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume pre-cache verification means checking committee membership before storing the attestation in any local cache or forwarding to other peers.

ambiguities.text: The 62x improvement in pairings is described for 'large networks' without specifying the exact validator count threshold.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 62x applies to networks with approximately 1,366 or more attestations per slot, which corresponds to current mainnet scale.

implicit_assumptions.description: All validators will upgrade to produce Electra-compatible attestations before the fork.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Validators producing old-format attestations will miss attestations in the first post-fork block and incur offline penalties.

implicit_assumptions.description: Pre-cache committee membership verification is sufficient to prevent all gossip mutation attacks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could pollute attestation caches with invalid committee assignments, causing aggregation failures or wasted computation.

implicit_assumptions.description: Bitvector encoding for committee_bits provides sufficient space savings compared to Bitlist.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Block sizes could exceed expected bounds, potentially causing propagation delays or validation issues.

implicit_assumptions.description: Chains with only 1/8 active proposers represent a reasonable worst-case scenario for voting data inclusion.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Chains with even fewer active proposers could have voting data excluded for longer periods.
